reuse.why: The sync side generalises downloadAkahuTransactions into a shared downloadStandardTransactions and reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked/findOrCreateBank, but the link side writes a new 'generic' linkBankSyncAccount used only by Fintegra instead of sharing with the existing provider link functions.

duplication.why: linkBankSyncAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade/insert account, payee, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event), adding a sixth copy of the link flow.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, matching the other providers.

scope.why: Focused on the server side; small client edits (provider key, readable name, fintegra:false) are forced by extending SYNC_PROVIDERS but touch the client the request said was separate.

maintainability.why: A helper named linkBankSyncAccount that only one provider uses invites confusion next to five hand-written copies; future changes to linking must still be made in six places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link abstraction existed in the tree; the existing assert/findOrCreateBank helpers are used.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount: the linkAkahuAccount body renamed and parameterised by provider but not adopted by the existing link functions.
